meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: Claude 会审查你给的文字，标出读起来像机器生成的句式和用词，并给出改写版本与改动说明。默认是改写模式，也能只标记问题，或就地把文件改掉。
howto.when: 当你要求去掉文中的 AI 腔、给草稿挑 AI 痕迹，或让它审查 README、更新日志等文本时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这段文字里的 AI 腔去掉，只标记问题、不要改
say.note: 进入 detect 模式，问题按严重程度分组列出

say.text: 按 casual 语气改写这篇博客，最多跑两轮
就地把这个 README 里机器味的地方改掉
say.note: edit 模式，大文件先确认改哪一节

howto.what_en: Claude audits your prose, quotes the patterns that read as machine-generated, and returns a cleaned rewrite with a summary of changes. Detect-only and edit-in-place modes are also available.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, or make a draft sound less like AI.

say_en.text: Flag the AI-isms in this text, don't rewrite it
say_en.note: Runs detect mode; issues grouped by severity

say_en.text: Rewrite this blog post in a casual voice, two passes max
Edit this README in place to remove machine-sounding prose
say_en.note: Edit mode; confirms the section first
